notes.title: Pre-Alpha Demo Update ver. 5.000162 Store and More!
notes.content:
We’re excited to share a new update for the Alien Up pre-alpha demo, featuring a range of improvements and changes based on your feedback. Check it out and let us know what you think about this version as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467505/e9ec385a893f09026604e5d8cc453df767bb0e2e.png
Here’s what’s new:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467505/73579b5d654ce289e6bec7961b95574778af6f5f.png

 Stage Select: Navigate and revisit stages with ease.
 Music Overhaul: Enjoy an improved soundtrack for a more immersive experience.
 Enhanced HP Bars: Bosses and barriers now have more visible health bars.
 Visual Reworks: Refined visuals throughout the demo.
 Event Reworks: Adjusted in-game events for better flow and engagement.
 Store/Soda System: New mechanics for trading sodas and earning upgrades.
 Level Updates: A new level concept has been added, and one level has been removed.
 Minor Tweaks: Countless small details to enhance the overall experience.

There may be even more updates we missed listing here (like the new assist character!), so dive in and explore. Thank you for your continued support and feedback!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467505/6fb7a197b1c07fbd60f636f33a6d717bf7a66f9a.png

notes.title: The First Demo has been Launched
notes.content:
Happy New Year! Alien Up is up and ready to play. Well, the demo is anyway. The game is still in development and a series of demos will be developed this year. I make these demos to get feedback on the good and the bad. The current demo available, as of this post, is the pre-alpha ver. 3.03567, the forth demo release. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43467505/d3b82b3ab94a5dcf5af70024b9820cc6e30c1532.png
Additions/Fixes from ver. 3.0:

Added a double jump ability
Put NPCs in the background
UI visual overhaul
Stage end screen work
SFX
Background changes
Door HP Bar addition
"Get Ready" stage start change
Alien Up[date] changes
and some minor tweaks to gameplay (especially to the stage where you can turn around.)


Known issues with this demo:

Chelsea might jump really high sometimes. The jump is not stable.
The double jump might cause Chelsea to jump out of the level. If this happens, press down and jump.
Moon Man AU mode is too difficult (Will fix in next demo)
Chelsea gets stuck in the floor (if this happens dying and continuing should reset her position,)

The forum will be set up soon for easy feedback suggestions so sit tight and look out for that. Once it is up I'll let you all know.

Thanks for playing my game! And there will be more news to come!
